deskyard describe: machine-readable description of every command

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] describe --json

Prints every command with its arguments, flags, output and exit codes as JSON,
to load as tool definitions.

Options:
  --json               JSON output (the only format)

Prints: {name, version, usage, globalFlags, environment, exitCodes,
  commands:[{name, group, summary, usage, description, arguments, flags,
  output, examples, where, exitCodes}]}

Examples:
  deskyard describe --json

Where: on this machine (no server needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
